acceptance: #4037 is closed with a comment naming the superseding change, or rebased onto origin/develop with green CI and an item tracking its remaining purpose.
Any behaviour #4037 had that develop lacks is either delivered or recorded as a tracker item; none is silently dropped.

context:
2026-11-11 side effect seen while this draft stays open: every `make pr-open` on six unrelated branches (#4098 to #4103) printed 'textual conflict with PR #4037 (fix/batch-evidence-develop-ci) in docs/agent/batch-feature-delivery.md, scripts/batch_integration.py, scripts/pr_landing.py, tests/unit/scripts/test_batch_evidence.py - coordinate before landing', although none of those branches touched the named files. The warning appears to compare the draft with develop rather than with the branch being opened, so it is noise for every author until #4037 is closed or rebased.

Owner decision 2026-11-12 (choice dialog): compare #4037 with develop; if develop already has everything, close it with a comment naming #4048; anything left over becomes a tracker item. Work started 2026-11-12 by the coordinating session; held so no other session claims it.
description:
Problem. Draft PR #4037 (fix/batch-evidence-develop-ci, 'keep one implementation of develop-deleted receipt path dropping') has not changed since 2026-11-07. Its review is still pending, and no tracker item references it. Since then, #4020 was reverted (#4038), and #4048 landed 'record ran_command on every rerun, drop develop-deleted test paths in overlap and fix reruns, fail closed when none remain'. #4037 may now be redundant or conflicting. A stalled draft that changes scripts/batch_integration.py also blocked another item's decision gate for about an hour on 2026-11-07.

Change. Compare #4037's diff with develop after #4048. If everything it does is already on develop, close it with a comment naming #4048. If something remains (for example a single shared implementation), rebase it onto develop, or file that remainder as its own item and close the draft.

Guardrails: never push to or edit another session's branch without the owner's go-ahead; a close needs a comment that states what superseded it; never bypass review.
